## What's new in AniTenshi 1.0.17

- **English and Italian everywhere**: the Google Drive messages are now in your language. This includes the page the browser shows after signing in, "Sync complete" and the sync errors. Any text that isn't translated into your language yet shows in English.
- **Clearer Google Drive messages**: if access to Google Drive expires or is removed, the app tells you to connect again instead of showing a technical error. If you cancel the sign-in or don't finish it within 5 minutes, it says so.
- **Release notes in English**: from this version on, the update notes are written in English.
